evidence_boundary: Local approximate metric convention: gross forward target returns, no fees, no execution or market impact. 2023-11, 2024-01 and 2024-03 are used development windows; 2023-11-01..14 is also the V3 validation month, so none of the three is an independent confirmation window. Stress buckets use 20-trading-day trailing medians from the official vwap table; a ~20-day month gives small bucket samples.
scope: Six frozen V3-recipe checkpoints replayed on 2023-11, 2024-01 and 2024-03; TLOB and MLPLOB ensembles blended post hoc at 75:25, 50:50 and 25:75.
